text: These mummies have been embalmed and reinforced with secret ointments and oils, making their bodies highly resistant to damage – but also highly flammable.
The mere touch of a mummy curses its opponents, sapping their strength and reducing their ability to fight back.

The towering frame of a skeletal Giant can be seen far and wide on the battlefield. As such, they are perfectly suited to serve as conduits to channel dark magic from the necromancer to his troops, anchoring them in the mortal world.
Just give the order and the Hydra's heads will spew forth their pestilent breath, each competing for the most noxious fumes.
